summary: Make REQUIRED_LABELS check case-insensitive so 'question' (GH canonical) satisfies 'Question' (no more WARN in health).
migration_impact: Health reports will now correctly show label_coverage_ok=true on repos where GH surfaces the label in lowercase. No action needed.
agent_notes: plate_health and bootstrap will see complete label coverage even if GH returns 'question'. Improves signals for new repo setup and beta readiness.
